# C11 — Page: Manage Questions

**Canonical URL:** `/manage/questions` *(per [`../C07-sitemap.md`](../../C07-sitemap.md))*
**Route name:** `entity.lms_question.collection` (auto-generated by `AdminHtmlRouteProvider`)
**Solution:** Drupal entity collection page auto-generated by `AdminHtmlRouteProvider` from `lms_question` entity annotation; CRUD routes at `/manage/questions`, `/manage/questions/add/{type}`, `/manage/questions/{id}/edit`, `/manage/questions/{id}/delete`.
**Owner module:** [`lms_question`](../../C05-modules/lms_question.md)
**Primary source:** `entity:lms_question`
**Editable source:** `lms_question` entity — fields: `name`, `field_body`, `field_points`, `field_explanation`, `field_difficulty`, bundle-specific answer fields (`field_choices`, `field_correct_answer`, `field_correct_answers`, `field_case_sensitive`, `field_matching_pairs`, `field_ordered_items`, `field_min_words`, `field_max_words`)
**Editor role:** Instructor / Administrator
**Editor management UI:** `/manage/questions` (list), `/manage/questions/add/{type}` (add by bundle), `/manage/questions/{id}/edit` (edit), `/manage/questions/{id}/delete` (delete)
**Revision / moderation:** Not revisionable; no workflow.
**Forms:** `Drupal\lms_question\Form\QuestionForm` (extends `ContentEntityForm`) — minimal override; handles add/edit/delete for all 8 bundles via the same form class
**Theme template:** Drupal core admin entity list template (no custom Twig; uses `claro` admin theme default list)
**Access:** Role-gated: `administer lms_course` (collection/add/edit/delete)
**Cache:** Drupal entity list builder cache; invalidated on `lms_question` entity save/delete.
**Translation:** Translatable (entity is `translatable: TRUE`); translation UI via Drupal core content translation.
**Related entities:** [`lms_question`](../../C04-entities/01-content-entities.md), [`lms_answer`](../../C04-entities/01-content-entities.md), [`lms_matching_pair`](../../C04-entities/01-content-entities.md), [`lms_question_type`](../../C04-entities/01-content-entities.md), [`lms_quiz`](../../C04-entities/01-content-entities.md)
**Prototype reference:** None — no dedicated C10 prototype for this page. Workspace quiz form embeds questions via `inline_entity_form` (see [manage-quizzes.md](manage-quizzes.md)).
**Notes:** The `manage/questions` URL surface is the **standalone question bank** CRUD. In practice, questions are more commonly added inline via the `field_questions` IEF widget inside the Quiz edit form. All 8 bundles share one `QuestionForm` class and all fields are defined on the base entity — bundle-specific fields are always rendered regardless of bundle (no conditional field hiding per bundle in the form). `lms_question_type` is a config entity providing the 8 bundles installed via `config/install/`.

## Components (visual order, top-to-bottom)

> Global chrome (header / primary nav / footer) is defined ONCE in [`../_common.md`](../_common.md) and NOT repeated here.

### 1. Entity List Table (Question Bank)

- **Scope:** Page-specific
- **Implementation mechanism:** Drupal core entity list builder (`EntityListBuilder` default, not a custom list builder) rendered via `AdminHtmlRouteProvider` collection route; displayed in `claro` admin theme
- **Plugin / Module:** `lms_question` (entity annotation) — no custom list builder class
- **Source content type / Entity:** `lms_question` (all bundles)
- **Backed by fields / config keys:** `name` (label), `type` (bundle = question type), `created`, `changed`; entity key `id`
- **Editable source:** `lms_question` entity via `/manage/questions/{id}/edit`
- **Editor role / permission:** `administer lms_course`
- **Editor management UI:** `/manage/questions`
- **Revision / moderation:** No
- **Translation source:** Content translation (entity is translatable)
- **Edit smoke:** Add question → appears in list; edit name → name updates in list
- **View mode / Projection:** Admin list (label + operations)
- **Region / Placement:** Full admin page (claro theme)
- **Notes:** No custom columns — default entity list shows label and operation links only. Question type (bundle) label shown if core list builder includes it.

### 2. Add Question Form (per bundle)

- **Scope:** Page-specific
- **Implementation mechanism:** Auto-generated add form route `/manage/questions/add/{type}`; bundle selected from URL; `QuestionForm::buildForm` renders all base fields regardless of bundle
- **Plugin / Module:** `lms_question`
- **Source content type / Entity:** `lms_question` new entity of chosen bundle
- **Backed by fields / config keys:** `name`, `field_body`, `field_points`, `field_explanation`, `field_difficulty`, plus all bundle-specific fields (all always rendered)
- **Editable source:** `lms_question` entity
- **Editor role / permission:** `administer lms_course` (via `checkCreateAccess`)
- **Editor management UI:** `/manage/questions/add/{type}` where `{type}` ∈ {essay, fill_blank, matching, multiple_choice, ordering, short_answer, single_choice, true_false}
- **Revision / moderation:** No
- **Translation source:** N/A (new entity)
- **Edit smoke:** Add single_choice question with choices → submit → question appears in list
- **View mode / Projection:** Form
- **Region / Placement:** Admin page
- **Notes:** `field_choices` uses `inline_entity_form` referencing `lms_answer` entities (requires `inline_entity_form` contrib). `field_matching_pairs` uses IEF referencing `lms_matching_pair`. All fields always present regardless of bundle — no conditional field visibility.

### 3. Edit Question Form

- **Scope:** Page-specific
- **Implementation mechanism:** Auto-generated edit form route `/manage/questions/{lms_question}/edit`; `QuestionForm::save()` redirects to collection
- **Plugin / Module:** `lms_question`
- **Source content type / Entity:** `lms_question` (upcasted from route)
- **Backed by fields / config keys:** All base fields (same as Add); entity upcasted via `entity:lms_question` parameter
- **Editable source:** `lms_question` entity
- **Editor role / permission:** `edit lms_course` (via `QuestionAccessControlHandler::checkAccess`)
- **Editor management UI:** `/manage/questions/{id}/edit`
- **Revision / moderation:** No
- **Translation source:** Content translation
- **Edit smoke:** Edit `field_points` → save → verify in question view
- **View mode / Projection:** Form
- **Region / Placement:** Admin page
- **Notes:** `QuestionAccessControlHandler`: view → `view lms_course`; update/delete → `edit lms_course`. Same form class for all bundles.

### 4. Delete Question Confirmation

- **Scope:** Page-specific
- **Implementation mechanism:** Auto-generated delete form route `/manage/questions/{lms_question}/delete`; uses core `ContentEntityDeleteForm`
- **Plugin / Module:** `lms_question`
- **Source content type / Entity:** `lms_question` (upcasted)
- **Backed by fields / config keys:** `name` (displayed in confirmation)
- **Editable source:** N/A (delete action)
- **Editor role / permission:** `edit lms_course`
- **Editor management UI:** `/manage/questions/{id}/delete`
- **Revision / moderation:** N/A
- **Translation source:** N/A
- **Edit smoke:** Delete question → removed from list
- **View mode / Projection:** Confirm form
- **Region / Placement:** Admin page
- **Notes:** Core delete form; no custom logic in `lms_question`.

| Answer/matching field labels | Field labels in entity definition code | Developer-owned base field labels | Revisit if field label customization is needed |
